..environment: Node >=22; zero dependencies. The engine spawns processes only through the capability you pass, so it is server and CLI only
..purpose: `defineRepoContract`, `runRepoContract`, `serializeRun`, `renderMarkdownSummary`, the `Evidence`, `Verdict` and `Policy` types, and the error classes

./presets.environment: Node (`crap`, `duplication`, `markdownlint`, `securitySecrets` and `test` read their own report file through `node:fs`; `mutation` reads the Stryker report and its registry; `brokenLinks` checks that local links exist on disk)
./presets.purpose: Ready-made checks for common tools: `typecheck`, `lint`, `format`, `test`, `securityDeps`, `license` and others, to spread and override

./helpers.environment: Node: node:crypto and node:fs/promises (the file system is injectable)
./helpers.purpose: Governed exceptions: `loadExceptionRegistry`, `reconcileExceptions`, `evaluateExceptionRecord`, the v2 record (`validateExceptionRegistry`, `loadAndReconcileExceptionRegistry`) and the registry inventory; `repoContractLogs` and its two hooks are beta

./affected.environment: Node >=22; pure: the TypeScript compiler API, git output and the cache store are passed in
./affected.purpose: Scope a run to what a change can reach and reuse unchanged results: `computeAffectedFromGit`, `resolveScope`, `parseScopeArgs`, `createCache`, `resolveCacheMode`

./metrics.purpose: Run records and what they prove: `createRunRecord`, `serializeRunRecord`, `summarizeRuns`, `pillarCoverage`, `maturityLevel`, `buildEvidenceManifest`, `verifyEvidenceManifest`

./tiers.environment: Node (the library-only checks read `package.json` through `node:fs` to tell whether the package is private)
./tiers.purpose: Four tiers of checks to spread into `defineRepoContract`: `basic`, `app`, `library`, `strict`, with one overrides object; `explainTier` and `renderExplain` say what a config loosened

./config.environment: Node (`entries` checks that a source file exists through `node:fs`)
./config.purpose: The shared inputs of the tool config helpers: `entries` from package.json `exports`, and one exclude list (`excludeGlobs`, `negateGlobs`, `DEFAULT_EXCLUDE`)

./config/tsup.purpose: `tsupConfig`: one tsup entry per code subpath of `exports`

./config/typedoc.purpose: `typedocConfig`: TypeDoc entry points from `exports`, and the shared exclude list

./config/knip.purpose: `knipConfig`: knip entries from `exports`, and a project glob without the shared exclude list

./config/vitest.purpose: `vitestConfig`: coverage settings that write the reports the `coverage` and `crap` presets read

./config/stryker.purpose: `strykerConfig`: a non-incremental Stryker config whose `mutate` set leaves out the shared exclude list

./schema.purpose: The JSON Schemas for the evidence and verdict documents `serializeRun` writes

dependencies.typescript: Only for `repo-contract/affected` and the `repo-contract affected` command, which read the project's own compiler API to follow imports (GUIDE.md's runtime support lists the versions). Nothing else loads it.
